intended_object: The local (hom-category) functor of the bicategorical Yoneda pseudofunctor: B(a,b) → Hom(B(-,a), B(-,b)), sending f to the strong transformation 'postcompose with f' and a 2-cell η to the modification given by whiskering with η. Inferred from docstring, name, and its use in `Bicategory.yoneda`.
explanation: On objects it uses `postcomp₂ f`, the strong transformation whose component at x is postcomposition by f on B(x,a) → B(x,b), with associators as naturality 2-cells. On morphisms it sends η to the modification with components `(postcomposingCat x a b).map η`, i.e. whiskering by η; the modification axiom is proved automatically. It is defined for an arbitrary bicategory, its natural generality. It is plugged into `PrelaxFunctor.mkOfHomFunctors` to define `Bicategory.yoneda`, so it is exactly the 1- and 2-cell action of the Yoneda pseudofunctor. The docstring calls it an implementation detail only in the sense that `yoneda.map` is the preferred API; mathematically it is a well-defined, standard construction and is defined correctly.
